name: Endive
siboNotes: Endive is well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to its low fiber content and minimal fermentable compounds.
preparationTips: Separate leaves gently to avoid bruising the delicate tips
Rinse briefly in cold water and pat dry thoroughly
Can be eaten raw in salads or braised to reduce bitterness
Store in refrigerator wrapped in damp paper towel for up to 5 days
nutritionalHighlights: High in folate for cellular health
Good source of vitamin K for bone health
Low in calories but high in water content
